title: Settings

preferences.helper: Sounds only play at the match and when the film is revealed.

analytics.label: Help improve the app
analytics.helper: Stats on the screens you open, so we can see what gets in the way. Never your swipes or your films.
analytics.helperStrict: They're anonymous. Detailed stats link them to your profile.

rateLimited.title: One download an hour
rateLimited.message: You just downloaded your data. Try again a little later.

delete.label: Delete my data
delete.title: Delete your data?
delete.body: Your name, your services and your movie night history are erased. Past votes stay in their rooms, without your name. You start fresh, like the first time you opened the app. This can't be undone.

errors.tryAgain: We couldn't delete your data just now. Nothing changed, so try again.

offline: You're offline. Downloading or deleting your data waits until you're back.

errors.offline: You're offline. Connect to download your data.
